sentences.en: JUDY: Good morning.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 早上好。

sentences.en: Total Insurance.
sentences.zh: 总计保险公司。

sentences.en: Judy speaking, how may I help you?
sentences.zh: 我是朱迪，有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: I recently shipped my belongings from overseas back here to Australia and I took out insurance with your company.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 我最近将我的物品从海外运回澳大利亚，当时在贵公司购买了保险。

sentences.en: Some items were damaged during the move so I need to make a claim.
sentences.zh: 运输过程中部分物品受损，因此我需要提出理赔申请。

sentences.en: What do I have to do?
sentences.zh: 我需要做些什么？

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay, well first I need to get a few details about this.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的，首先我需要了解一些相关细节。

sentences.en: Can you give me your name please?
sentences.zh: 请问您怎么称呼？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Yes.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 好的。

sentences.en: It's Michael Alexander.
sentences.zh: 我叫迈克尔·亚历山大。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的。

sentences.en: And your address please?
sentences.zh: 请问您的地址是？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: My old address or my current one?
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 您是指我的旧地址还是现在的地址？

sentences.en: JUDY: Your current one.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 请提供您当前的地址。

sentences.en: MICHAEL: It's 24 Manly Street, Milperra near Sydney.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 地址是悉尼附近的米尔佩拉曼利街24号。

sentences.en: JUDY: What was the suburb, sorry?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 抱歉，请问郊区名称是什么？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Milperra.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 米尔佩拉。

sentences.en: M-I-L-P-E-R-R-A.
sentences.zh: M-I-L-P-E-R-R-A。

sentences.en: JUDY: Right.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 明白了。

sentences.en: Now, who was the shipping agent Mr Alexander?
sentences.zh: 亚历山大先生，承运代理公司是哪家？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: You mean the company we used?
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 您是指我们所用的那家公司吗？

sentences.en: JUDY: Yes, the company who packed everything up at the point of origin.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 是的，就是负责在起运地打包所有货物的那家公司。

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Oh, it was er . . .
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 哦，是……

sentences.en: First Class Movers.
sentences.zh: 一级搬家公司。

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay .
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的。

sentences.en: where were the goods shipped from?
sentences.zh: 那么，这批货物是从哪里运出的？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: China, but the ship came via Singapore and was there for about a week.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 中国，但货船经停新加坡，并在那里停留了大约一周时间。

sentences.en: JUDY: Don't worry, all of that information will be in the documentation.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 不用担心，所有这些信息都会在相关文件中体现。

sentences.en: Now, the dates.
sentences.zh: 接下来是日期问题。

sentences.en: Do you know when the ship arrived?
sentences.zh: 您知道货船抵达的时间吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: it left on the 11th of October and got to Sydney on the 28th of November.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 货船于10月11日出发，11月28日抵达悉尼。

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的。

sentences.en: I need one more a thing.
sentences.zh: 我还需确认一项信息。

sentences.en: There's a reference number.
sentences.zh: 有一个参考编号。

sentences.en: It should be in the top right-hand corner of the pink form they gave you.
sentences.zh: 它应位于他们交给您的粉色表格右上角。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts †.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 笔记稿 †。

sentences.en: SLA
sentences.zh: SLA

sentences.en: MICHAEL: a Let me have a look.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 让我找一下。

sentences.en: I have so many papers.
sentences.zh: 我手头的文件太多了。

sentences.en: Yes, here it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，就在这里。

sentences.en: It's 601 ACK.
sentences.zh: 它是601 ACK。

sentences.en: JUDY: Thanks.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 谢谢。

sentences.en: topsage.com
sentences.zh: topsage.com

sentences.en: JUDY: I need to take down a few details of the actual damage over the phone before you put in a full report.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 我需要先在电话里记录下实际受损情况的若干细节，然后再提交完整报告。

sentences.en: Can you tell me how many items were damaged and what the damage was?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我有多少件物品受损，以及具体损坏情况吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Yes, well four things actually.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 好的，实际上有四件。

sentences.en: I'll start with the big things.
sentences.zh: 我先从大件开始说。

sentences.en: My TV first of all.
sentences.zh: 首先是我的电视机。

sentences.en: It's a large one . . . very expensive.
sentences.zh: 它是一台大型电视机……非常昂贵。

sentences.en: JUDY: Our insurance doesn't cover electrical problems.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 我们的保险不承保电器故障问题。

sentences.en: MICHAEL: It isn't an electrical problem.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 这并非电器故障问题。

sentences.en: The screen has a huge crack in it so it's unusable.
sentences.zh: 屏幕出现了一道巨大的裂痕，因此已无法使用。

sentences.en: JUDY: see.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 明白了。

sentences.en: Any idea of the price to repair it?
sentences.zh: 您知道维修它大概要多少钱吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: No.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 不知道。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think it can be repaired.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得它根本无法修复。

sentences.en: It will need a new one.
sentences.zh: 必须更换一台新的。

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll make a note of that and we'll see what we can do.
sentences.zh: 我会记下这一点，然后看看我们能做些什么。

sentences.en: Now, what was the second item?
sentences.zh: 那么，第二件物品是什么？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: The cabinet from the bathroom was damaged as well.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 卫生间里的那个橱柜也受损了。

sentences.en: It's a lovely cabinet, we use it to keep our towels in.
sentences.zh: 那是一个很漂亮的橱柜，我们用它来存放毛巾。

sentences.en: JUDY: And what is the extent of the damage?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 损坏程度如何？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Well, the back and the sides seem okay but the door has a huge hole in it.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 嗯，背板和侧板看起来还好，但柜门上有一个很大的洞。

sentences.en: It can't be repaired.
sentences.zh: 它无法修复。

sentences.en: I'm really not very happy about it.
sentences.zh: 我对此真的非常不满。

sentences.en: JUDY: And how much do you think it will cost to replace it?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 那么，您估计更换它需要多少钱？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Well, when bought it last year paid $125 for it.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 嗯，去年购买时花了125美元。

sentences.en: But the one I've seen here in Sydney is a bit more expensive, it's $140.
sentences.zh: 但我在悉尼看到的同款稍贵一些，要140美元。

sentences.en: JUDY: Right, and what was the third item?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的，第三件物品是什么？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: My dining room table.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 我的餐厅餐桌。

sentences.en: It's a lovely table from Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 这是一张来自印度尼西亚的漂亮餐桌。

sentences.en: It must have been very hot inside the container because one leg has completely split down the middle.
sentences.zh: 集装箱内部温度一定非常高，因为其中一条桌腿从中完全裂开了。

sentences.en: The top and the other three look okay thank goodness.
sentences.zh: 桌面和其他三条桌腿还好，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: JUDY: Any idea of the price to repair it?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 您知道维修它大概要多少钱吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Well. had an estimate done on this actually because it is a very special table to us.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 嗯，实际上我们已为这张桌子做了估价，因为它对我们来说非常特别。

sentences.en: They quoted us $200, which is really pricey so I hope the insurance will cover the total cost.
sentences.zh: 对方给我们报了200美元，价格确实很高，所以我希望保险能全额赔付。

sentences.en: JUDY: I'm sure that will be fine.
sentences.zh: JUDY: 我相信这应该没问题。

sentences.en: What was the last item, Mr Alexander?
sentences.zh: 亚历山大先生，最后一件物品是什么？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Well, we have a lovely set of china plates and dishes, you know, with matching cups, saucers, the lot.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 呃，我们有一套非常漂亮的瓷器盘子和碟子，您知道的，还有配套的杯子、茶碟，全套都有。

sentences.en: They were all in the one box which must have got dropped because some plates were broken - six actually.
sentences.zh: 它们全都装在一个箱子里，那个箱子肯定被摔过，因为有些盘子碎了——实际上有六只。

sentences.en: JUDY: And can you tell me the replacement value of these?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 您能告诉我这些物品的重置价值吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Well, it's hard to say because they were part of a set but they can be up to $10 each as it's such a good set.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 这个很难说，因为它们是一整套餐具的一部分，但单件最高可达10美元，毕竟这是一套非常优质的餐具。

sentences.en: JUDY: Okay, so that would be around $60 altogether?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 好的，那么总共大约是60美元？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: JUDY: And is that all of the items?
sentences.zh: JUDY: 这些就是全部物品了吗？

sentences.en: MICHAEL: Yes.
sentences.zh: MICHAEL: 是的。

sentences.en: So what do have to do now?
sentences.zh: 那么我们现在需要做些什么？
